rationale: TIS root domain is a recurring publisher of Slovak procurement datasets, methodologies and red-flag criteria — monitor the parent, not the sub-pages.
Standalone contract mirror with RSS and red-flag scoring; url_verification failed so re-check liveness before approving.
Own subdomain, continuously updated community scoring of state IT/payments procurements — signal absent from raw notices.
Practitioner forum on its own subdomain that keeps producing current API/dataset intelligence and new source leads.
Commercial TED/UVO monitoring service named in cell scope; subscription/registration must be cleared by a human.
Extends coverage to EKS/JOSEPHINE/ERANET platform purchases, but is a paid analytics product requiring access clearance.
Value is its stated upstream feed list — mine once as a map of channels to harvest, then archive.
NGO that recurrently publishes UVO-based quantitative analyses giving regime context for tender time-series.
EU PPDS is an open, licence-clear independent mirror of Slovak procurement datasets with stable machine-readable output.
Canonical NBS licence database generating the Slovak banking and payments actor universe; continuously updated.
Daily-refreshed PSD2 JSON API — directly ingestible structured seed of payments-sector actors with ICO.
Hub index of NBS registers; mine once to snowball to the individual registers that are the real feeds.
Standalone regulator register of financial agents on its own subdomain; distribution-layer actors adjacent to bank procurement.
Licensed non-bank creditor register — in-scope adjacent buyers of core-banking and card technology; own subdomain, public.
DORA guidance section of nbs.sk already reached via the register index; entity-level ICT vendor data likely unpublished.
SBA member list is a compact curated buyer universe (>99% of the sector) — mine once, refresh occasionally.
Explicit member-listing page for ~32 leasing entities that procure IT/payments separately; one-off enumeration.
Fintech association membership reveals the payments challenger/vendor side missing from NBS licence registers.
Second, distinct fintech/insurtech body; needed alongside SFA to close the payments vendor-universe gap.
Statutory, continuously updated register linking public-contract suppliers to beneficial owners — highest-yield A2 actor source.
Third-party RPVS mirror useful for easier bulk enumeration; secondary to the official register, mine once.
UVO register of pre-qualified economic operators — the standing bidder universe for Slovak public contracts.
National business register supplying the ICO join key that links licence registers, RPVS and award notices.
Free no-key REST API consolidating state registers under CC-BY; useful bulk name-to-ICO resolution, secondary to official sources.
